item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Sets `num_candidate_programs=1`, compiles, inspects `best.candidate_programs`, and asserts a stored count of 4, reproducing the three built-ins plus one requested candidate."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Checks for seeds `{-3,-2,-1,0}`, matching the built-in baseline seeds and the single nonnegative random candidate `0`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Directly reads `best.candidate_programs` and extracts each `candidate[\"seed\"]`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Prints `len(seeds), seeds` and asserts `len(seeds) == 4` plus `set(seeds) == {-3, -2, -1, 0}`."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `set(seeds)` for the seed assertion, so it does not rely on any fixed ordering after sorting."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
